Approximate quantiles added to the [approximate statistics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ncruces/go-sqlite3/ext/approx) package in #443.
The `database/sql` driver now uses `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transactions by default. You can change the default with `_txlock` (as previously), and as the docs state:
- [`LevelLinearizable`](https://pkg.go.dev/database/sql#IsolationLevel) transactions are always `EXCLUSIVE`;
- [`LevelSerializable`](https://pkg.go.dev/database/sql#IsolationLevel) transactions are always `IMMEDIAT

Removed [`FCNTL_NULL_IO`](https://www.sqlite.org/c3ref/c_fcntl_begin_atomic_write.html#sqlitefcntlnullio), which was broken and impossible to use correctly.
Used to implement bitwise aggregates `bit_and` and `bit_or`, and a new [approximate statistics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ncruces/go-sqlite3/ext/approx) package.
- SQLite 3.54.1, with an [upstream fix](https://sqlite.org/src/info/535a77cf5a).
